crispy.content:
Create a home-style cooking step infographic for 【{argument name="dish name" default="Sweet and Sour Pork"}】.

【Overall Style】
- Style: 8K ultra-HD realistic photography style, professional quality suitable for a food magazine
- Image Quality: 8K resolution, sharp details, professional food photography lighting
- Background: Real kitchen scene/marble countertop/wooden cutting board, shallow depth of field blur
- Color Palette: Natural and realistic colors, true colors of ingredients, warm lighting
- Layout: Horizontal 16:9

【Top Title Area】
- Main dish title (elegant Chinese font)
- Subtitle: Cooking time / Difficulty level / Serving size
- Background can use a blurred close-up of the finished dish

【Left or Top - Ingredient List Area】
- Title: "Ingredient Preparation"
- All ingredients arranged realistically, neatly organized from a top-down view (flat lay)
- Each ingredient labeled with name and quantity
- Style: Instagram-style ingredient flat lay photography

【Main Body - Cooking Steps Area】
- 6-8 steps, arranged in a grid or timeline
- Each step includes:
  * Step number (simple numeric identifier)
  * Close-up photo of the actual cooking process:
    - Cutting meat: Knife skills details, meat texture
    - Blanching: Boiling water, foam
    - Caramelizing sugar: Caramel color, oily sheen
    - Stir-frying: Dynamic movement in the wok, flame
    - Stewing/Simmering: Sauce bubbling, steam rising
    - Reducing sauce: Thick sauce, glossy meat pieces
  * Brief descriptive text (1-2 sentences)
  * Heat/Time notation

【Bottom - Finished Dish Display Area】
- 8K high-definition photo of the finished dish
- Professional plating, exquisite tableware
- Shot at a 45-degree angle or top-down view
- Visible food texture: Gloss of the sauce, fibers of the meat, rising steam
- Background: Dining table setting, chopsticks, small side dishes for garnish

【Photography Specifications】
- Lighting: Side-back light/natural window light, creating appetite appeal
- Depth of Field: Subject sharp, background naturally blurred
- Texture: Visible ingredient texture, oil sheen, reflection of the sauce
- Steam: Real steam visible in hot dish steps
- Color Temperature: Warm tone (5500-6000K), enhancing appetite

【Auxiliary Elements】
- Tips notation: Key techniques (e.g., "Blanch in cold water to remove odor," "Simmer slowly for 40 minutes")
- Heat icon: 🔥 notation for heat level in each step
- Timer notation: Duration for key steps
- All ingredient quantities, step details, time, and heat should be automatically generated accurately based on the dish

crispy.content:
Technical architectural blueprint of KÖFTE & PATATES on deep navy blue drafting paper #0A1628. Hyperrealistic photorealistic food hero centered and dramatically lit — warm studio spotlight from upper left, soft fill from right, visible steam wisps and sauce drips frozen mid-motion in full color. Food rendered with obsessive detail: glistening textures, visible moisture, char marks, melting elements catching light. Blueprint linework in crisp electric blue #4A90D9 — precise measurement lines, dimension arrows, cross-section callouts, grid overlay, compass rose bottom-left, scale bar bottom-center, revision block top-right.
LABELS: Each ingredient connected by a thin glowing electric blue line with a sharp 90-degree elbow joint — exactly like a professional CAD drawing. Label text in bright white Helvetica Neue Light uppercase, ingredient name bold, descriptor below in thin italic: "INGREDIENT NAME — qty: X — preparation method, texture descriptor, origin".
Food positioned left-of-center. All labels clustered right side and top, lines fanning outward cleanly with no crossovers.
Main components from top to bottom:
- PİDE EKMEĞİ — butter-toasted, golden edges, 110mm DIA. sesame-sprinkled optional.
- DOMATES DİLİMLERİ — vine-ripened, jewel-red, thick-cut 8mm THICK.
- SOĞAN HALKALARI — thinly sliced, sharp, translucent.
- KÖFTE — qty: 3-4 — 80g each, hand-minced dana kıyma + baharat (kimyon, pul biber, soğan rendesi, maydanoz), grilled/charred edges, juicy center, 90mm DIA smashed style.
- PATATES — qty: generous portion — ince uzun kesilmiş, double-fried, extra crispy exterior, fluffy interior, golden-brown, 120mm length avg.
- ZEYTİNYAĞLI SALÇA SOS / ACUKA — tangy-spicy, rich red, drizzled 25g.
- MAYDANOZ & SUMAK — fresh green, bright red dusting.
Bottom-right title block with double border: "DISH: KÖFTE & PATATES TABAK // CLASSIFICATION: TÜRK EGE USULÜ // BUILD SPEC: çıtır çıtır patates, sulu köfte, tam kararında pişmiş, bağımlılık garantili."
Mood: NASA food engineering meets Michelin lokanta — clinical precision with irresistible appetite appeal. Dramatic, extraordinary, craveable. 4K, tack sharp, electric blue linework glowing softly, warm food tones popping against cool navy.

crispy.content:
Luxury Korean tasting menu, editorial layout, 2+2 large grid composition, 4:5 aspect ratio.

LAYOUT: 2x2 large grid, with two hero images on top and two supporting images below, balanced asymmetric arrangement

BACKGROUND: Tone-on-tone panels - alternating deep crimson (#800000), ochre (#CC7722), and celadon (#ACE1AF), creating warm yet appetizing rhythm

PRODUCT EXPRESSION: Product only, overhead and 45-degree angles mixed, plated presentation on artisanal black ceramics and traditional Korean wooden trays

TONE STRATEGY: Monochrome red/brown/green - Korean dish colors harmonize with background tones, seamless blend with pops of natural food color

MAIN ELEMENTS:
Hero Image 1 (top left): {argument name="hero dish 1" default="Bossam (boiled pork belly) plated with kimchi and ssamjang (fermented soybean paste)"}
Hero Image 2 (top right): {argument name="hero dish 2" default="Bibimbap (mixed rice with vegetables and beef) with gochujang (chili pepper paste), egg yolk, and sesame oil"}
Supporting Image 1 (bottom left): Galbijjim (braised short ribs) in a dark glossy sauce with chestnuts and ginko nuts
Supporting Image 2 (bottom right): Bingsu (shaved ice dessert) with red bean paste, condensed milk, and various fruits

TYPOGRAPHY: Bilingual - English names in elegant light serif (Didot), Hangul below in clean sans-serif, small ingredient descriptions in light gray

CAMERA: Canon EOS R5, 100mm Macro for details, 50mm for full plates, soft diffused overhead lighting, butterfly lighting

STYLE: Minimal + Luxury hybrid - generous whitespace, refined typography, Korean dish colors as only color source, shot by Annie Leibovitz

Style keywords: fine dining menu, Korean editorial, monochrome harmony, quiet luxury, bilingual design.. A stylish handwritten signature Willy is elegantly and small letters placed at the Bottom Right corner.

crispy.content:
An ultra-photorealistic, highly stylized fine art photograph. {argument name="subject" default="Sydney Sweeney"}, styled dramatically as Cleopatra in ancient Egyptian gold and jewel-toned attire, is reclining languidly on a colossal, floating barge. The barge is a masterpiece of confectionary architecture, sculpted entirely from golden-brown, flaky baklava, dripping with clear sugar syrup and heavily dusted with edible 24k gold leaf and crushed pistachios.

The barge navigates vast, reflective rivers of thick, viscous dark amber honey, which casts deep, warm reflections. In the distance, massive, geometrically perfect pyramids rise, constructed entirely from textured, off-white marzipan, meticulously adorned with fine saffron threads and sesame seeds.

**Composition and Detail:** Low-angle wide shot, emphasizing the scale of the food architecture and the drama of the environment. Extreme attention to the textures: the sharp crispness of the baklava layers, the glossy sheen of the flowing honey, and the slightly granular, matte quality of the marzipan pyramids.

**Lighting and Atmosphere:** Cinematic studio lighting setup. Dominant warm, golden-hour fill lights emphasizing the opulence of the gold leaf and the deep amber tones of the honey. A powerful, focused rim light defines the edges of Cleopatra's form and highlights the flaky layers of the baklava barge. Subtle volumetric haze and golden dust motes float above the honey, creating a dreamy, luxurious atmosphere.

**Camera Settings:** Shot on Hasselblad X2D, 85mm lens, f/1.4. Highly detailed, cinematic aspect ratio (21:9), deep depth of field, 16K resolution, hyper-detailed food art photography.
---

Create a home-style cooking step infographic for 【{argument name="dish name" default="Sweet and Sour Pork"}】.

【Overall Style】
- Style: 8K ultra-HD realistic photography style, professional quality suitable for a food magazine
- Image Quality: 8K resolution, sharp details, professional food photography lighting
- Background: Real kitchen scene/marble countertop/wooden cutting board, shallow depth of field blur
- Color Palette: Natural and realistic colors, true colors of ingredients, warm lighting
- Layout: Horizontal 16:9

【Top Title Area】
- Main dish title (elegant Chinese font)
- Subtitle: Cooking time / Difficulty level / Serving size
- Background can use a blurred close-up of the finished dish

【Left or Top - Ingredient List Area】
- Title: "Ingredient Preparation"
- All ingredients arranged realistically, neatly organized from a top-down view (flat lay)
- Each ingredient labeled with name and quantity
- Style: Instagram-style ingredient flat lay photography

【Main Body - Cooking Steps Area】
- 6-8 steps, arranged in a grid or timeline
- Each step includes:
  * Step number (simple numeric identifier)
  * Close-up photo of the actual cooking process:
    - Cutting meat: Knife skills details, meat texture
    - Blanching: Boiling water, foam
    - Caramelizing sugar: Caramel color, oily sheen
    - Stir-frying: Dynamic movement in the wok, flame
    - Stewing/Simmering: Sauce bubbling, steam rising
    - Reducing sauce: Thick sauce, glossy meat pieces
  * Brief descriptive text (1-2 sentences)
  * Heat/Time notation

【Bottom - Finished Dish Display Area】
- 8K high-definition photo of the finished dish
- Professional plating, exquisite tableware
- Shot at a 45-degree angle or top-down view
- Visible food texture: Gloss of the sauce, fibers of the meat, rising steam
- Background: Dining table setting, chopsticks, small side dishes for garnish

【Photography Specifications】
- Lighting: Side-back light/natural window light, creating appetite appeal
- Depth of Field: Subject sharp, background naturally blurred
- Texture: Visible ingredient texture, oil sheen, reflection of the sauce
- Steam: Real steam visible in hot dish steps
- Color Temperature: Warm tone (5500-6000K), enhancing appetite

【Auxiliary Elements】
- Tips notation: Key techniques (e.g., "Blanch in cold water to remove odor," "Simmer slowly for 40 minutes")
- Heat icon: 🔥 notation for heat level in each step
- Timer notation: Duration for key steps
- All ingredient quantities, step details, time, and heat should be automatically generated accurately based on the dish

Technical architectural blueprint of KÖFTE & PATATES on deep navy blue drafting paper #0A1628. Hyperrealistic photorealistic food hero centered and dramatically lit — warm studio spotlight from upper left, soft fill from right, visible steam wisps and sauce drips frozen mid-motion in full color. Food rendered with obsessive detail: glistening textures, visible moisture, char marks, melting elements catching light. Blueprint linework in crisp electric blue #4A90D9 — precise measurement lines, dimension arrows, cross-section callouts, grid overlay, compass rose bottom-left, scale bar bottom-center, revision block top-right.
LABELS: Each ingredient connected by a thin glowing electric blue line with a sharp 90-degree elbow joint — exactly like a professional CAD drawing. Label text in bright white Helvetica Neue Light uppercase, ingredient name bold, descriptor below in thin italic: "INGREDIENT NAME — qty: X — preparation method, texture descriptor, origin".
Food positioned left-of-center. All labels clustered right side and top, lines fanning outward cleanly with no crossovers.
Main components from top to bottom:
- PİDE EKMEĞİ — butter-toasted, golden edges, 110mm DIA. sesame-sprinkled optional.
- DOMATES DİLİMLERİ — vine-ripened, jewel-red, thick-cut 8mm THICK.
- SOĞAN HALKALARI — thinly sliced, sharp, translucent.
- KÖFTE — qty: 3-4 — 80g each, hand-minced dana kıyma + baharat (kimyon, pul biber, soğan rendesi, maydanoz), grilled/charred edges, juicy center, 90mm DIA smashed style.
- PATATES — qty: generous portion — ince uzun kesilmiş, double-fried, extra crispy exterior, fluffy interior, golden-brown, 120mm length avg.
- ZEYTİNYAĞLI SALÇA SOS / ACUKA — tangy-spicy, rich red, drizzled 25g.
- MAYDANOZ & SUMAK — fresh green, bright red dusting.
Bottom-right title block with double border: "DISH: KÖFTE & PATATES TABAK // CLASSIFICATION: TÜRK EGE USULÜ // BUILD SPEC: çıtır çıtır patates, sulu köfte, tam kararında pişmiş, bağımlılık garantili."
Mood: NASA food engineering meets Michelin lokanta — clinical precision with irresistible appetite appeal. Dramatic, extraordinary, craveable. 4K, tack sharp, electric blue linework glowing softly, warm food tones popping against cool navy.

A coffee's journey board from {argument name="origin" default="[ORIGIN]"} to cup {argument name="variety process roaster" default="[VARIETY / PROCESS / ROASTER]"}.
Three-panel documentary photography layout, shot on medium format. No illustrations. No flat graphics. No hand-drawn elements.
Left panel, The Origin: Aerial and macro photography of a specific hillside farm at {argument name="altitude" default="[ALTITUDE]"}m, morning mist still on the canopy. Extreme close-up of a picker's weathered hands selecting red cherries. Wet mill or raised drying beds photographed mid-process, real equipment, real workers, natural light. Varietal name and altitude typeset in clean serif over the image.
Center panel, The Transformation: Burlap sacks stacked in a warehouse, origin ink stamps in focus. Interior of a roastery drum roaster glowing amber through a porthole, heat haze visible. A minimal line graph of the roast curve overlaid in white type, first crack and second crack marked as timestamps. Macro shot of roasted beans mid-pour, steam catching side light.
Right panel, The Cup: A ceramic pour-over in progress, water threading in a slow spiral, the bloom exhaling upward in real steam. Final cup resting on a worn café table in warm morning window light. Tasting notes [NOTES] set in light italic type floating near the rim, not illustrated, typographic only.
Color arc: Tropical green → roastery amber → café morning gold. Cinematic color grading, not illustrated.
Title block: "[COFFEE NAME] [FARM], [REGION], [ALTITUDE]M, [PROCESS], [ROAST PROFILE]" — typeset in bold condensed sans-serif across the top.
